description: Use this when the user needs output or failure and billing details from an existing Freebeat task. Call after get_task_status returns completed, failed, or action_required. Failed or paused tasks return failure and billing even without final media. When an agent video is action_required, read get_video_session and use send_video_agent_message with the same task_id to continue in either mode. Polling a song-driven video may start its final video assembly from already generated assets; it does not regenerate source assets. Song-driven videos from generate_music_video, generate_dance_video, and generate_lyric_video, plus effects, singing, and lip-sync tasks, return result.video_url and usually result.cover_url; music tasks return result.audio_url. Song-driven video assembly still in progress returns running with a message to poll again. Other pending or running tasks return TASK_NOT_COMPLETED. If the task failed, this tool surfaces the backend failure. For Open RPC image/video batches, get result URLs from get_task_status instead.

task_id.description: Task ID returned by a generation tool

name: get_task_result

outputSchema.description: On success, returns the tool result fields. On error, returns success:false, error and code, with optional credit approval details; success-only fields are absent.

message.description: A human-readable summary of the completed task result.

result.description: The structured output payload for the completed task. Video tasks return video_url; music tasks return audio_url. Both may include cover_url and other metadata.

music_id.description: Pass this generated music reference directly to a song-driven video tool.

status.description: The normalized task status; unrecognized upstream values become unknown.

anyOf.description: Whether the task result was retrieved successfully.

task_type.description: The task category returned by Freebeat.
